name: Band Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back with the band looped around both forefeet and an end held beside each hip.
Press your hands against the floor and brace your abdomen with your legs extended.
Lift both legs together toward the ceiling while keeping your pelvis steady.
Lower your heels toward the floor without letting your lower back arch.
tips: Keep the band across the arches of your feet so it stays clear of your toes.
Shorten the descent or soften your knees if you lose control of your pelvis.
